description: High-performance Rust implementation for predicting ROIs for AprilTag detection using extrapolated camera motion.

camera_bus_id.description: Camera USB bus ID used to resolve calibration files (for example: '0' or '0-1').

apriltag_map_path.description: Path to fmap AprilTag map file.

padding_factor.description: Fractional padding to apply around projected tag bounds.

max_regions.description: Maximum number of ROI regions to return.

min_region_size_px.description: Minimum side length for ROI squares in pixels. ROIs smaller than this are rejected.

max_detection_distance_m.description: Maximum 3D distance in meters from the camera to the tag center for ROI generation. Tags beyond this distance are not searched. Zero disables the limit.
